report_title: VISTA Pre-Finals ML Pipeline Validation & Prototype Freeze Report
executive_summary: The VISTA machine learning pipeline and IPsec testbed prototype have been audited, reproduced, and frozen for SIH Pre-Finals evaluation. The pipeline contains zero unresolved data leakage defects, maintains strict session-level grouping, and enforces production admission guards. Empirical research limitations including recipe-specific correlation and closed-world application boundaries are disclosed and substantiated.

recipe_shortcuts.description: Fixed ping echo request/reply payloads produce std_packet_size == 0.0, cleanly separating ICMP from TCP and HTTP in controlled recipes.
Discrete traffic generation schedules sampled discrete packet counts in Phase 8 (ICMP: 6-14, TCP: 12-34, HTTP: 21-74).
recipe_shortcuts.risk_classification: Recipe-specific correlation; tested under varied counts in Phase 12

recipe_shortcuts.description: Ping echoes produce exactly 0.500 forward/backward ratio due to 1:1 request/reply matching.
recipe_shortcuts.risk_classification: Protocol invariant under lab ping; limits generalization to arbitrary web traffic

phase13_closed_world_fallacy_demonstrati.classification_outcome: 15/15 misclassified as controlled_http (0% accuracy on unseen class)
phase13_closed_world_fallacy_demonstrati.scientific_finding: Empirically proves closed-world limitation; outer-ESP models cannot perform arbitrary open-world application identification without out-of-distribution rejection.

candidate_production_safeguards.model_service_enforcement: VERIFIED_ACTIVE; ModelService blocks predictions for candidates where validated_for_inference is false or feature schema does not match.
candidate_production_safeguards.ui_guards: Unsupported predictions displayed as experimental / unavailable; no hardcoded synthetic bypasses.

backend_test_suite.skip_rationale: 10 tests skipped correspond to opt-in live testbed scenarios requiring VISTA_LIVE_VPN_TEST=1.

live_testbed_verification.verification: Live StrongSwan IPsec tunnel established between PC1 and PC2, ICMP traffic transmitted and captured, SA counters verified, and baseline restored.

git_diff_check.status: CLEAN; zero whitespace errors or merge markers.

2. Session-level train/test separation and held-out evaluation integrity verified
3. Existing evaluation results are reproducible or discrepancies documented
4. Recipe-specific correlation and small-sample limitations disclosed
6. Core prototype demonstration works with real evidence
7. Relevant tests pass, and all failures or skipped tests disclosed
8. Repository instructions and submission evidence ready
